usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.conversations.items.retrieve("conv_123", "msg_abc", include=["file_search_call.results"])
print(result)

fields.name: include
fields.description:
Additional fields to include in the response. See the `include`
parameter for [listing Conversation items above](/docs/api-reference/conversations/list-items#conversations_list_items-include) for more information.
